name: WSFX Global Pay Limited
summary: WSFX Global Pay Limited operates as a financial services firm, with a core focus on foreign exchange and international money transfers. The company provides a comprehensive suite of offerings, including prepaid forex cards, outward remittance solutions, and currency exchange services. These offerings cater to a diverse clientele, such as corporate professionals on business trips, leisure tourists, students studying abroad, and the millennial demographic. Established on April 25, 1986, WSFX Global Pay Limited maintains its principal office in Mumbai, India.
